2121:status_line_jev_in_scope() {  # <status-line>
2122-  local line=$1 verb
2123-  [ -n "$line" ] || return 1
2124-  status_line_verb "$line" verb
2125-  case "$verb" in
2126-    working|done|needs-decision|blocked|failed|\
2127-"${FM_CLASSIFY_PAUSED_VERB:-$FM_CLASSIFY_PAUSED_VERB_DEFAULT}"|\
2128-"${FM_CLASSIFY_CAPTAIN_HELD_VERB:-$FM_CLASSIFY_CAPTAIN_HELD_VERB_DEFAULT}")
2129-      return 1 ;;
2130-    *) return 0 ;;
2131-  esac
2132-}
2133-
2134-# 0 when Jev's captain_relevant Noul on <status-line> says escalate. 1 for
2135-# every other outcome - a valid low Noul, a helper error or timeout, a missing
2136-# helper, an invalid answer - so the caller's deterministic verdict stands.
2137-# The declared-verb gate runs first, so a direct caller can never accidentally
2138-# offer a terminal or absorb-declared line to the model.
2139-# <status-file> names the task and its state directory for the helper's data
2140-# boundary (fm_jev_supervision_free_text_ok in bin/fm-jev-lib.sh); without it
2141-# the helper sends structured facts only.
2142-status_line_jev_escalates() {  # <status-line> [<status-file>]
2143-  local line=$1 file=${2-} verdict task dir
2144-  local -a args=()
2145-  status_line_jev_in_scope "$line" || return 1
2146-  if [ -n "$file" ]; then
2147-    task=${file##*/}
2148-    task=${task%.status}
2149-    dir=${file%/*}
2150-    [ "$dir" != "$file" ] || dir=.
2151-    [ -z "$task" ] || args=(--task "$task" --state-dir "$dir")
